dedupe_keys.name: m find u s manufacturing facility inventory national dataset

description: M-FIND is a standardised inventory of 340,229 manufacturing facilities in the United States (excluding the territories), one row per facility, with address, county FIPS code, latitude and longitude, one or more NAICS industry codes, the area of the matched land parcel, the building footprint and building count on that parcel, and a flag for facilities that share a parcel. The Zenodo page and codebook say the team reconciled records from 13 public sources (EPA FRS, GHGRP and NEI, OSHA and Climate TRACE among them) with a hierarchical matching approach, then matched facilities to parcels; parcel polygons come from LightBox SmartParcels and are not redistributed, and building polygons come from Microsoft Building Footprints. Version 1.1 was published on 6 August 2026 by Rose Billings and nine co-authors as a downloadable CSV of about 55 MB with a text codebook, free under CC BY 4.0, with national coverage of the contiguous and non-contiguous states. Caveats: only facilities matched to a parcel are included, so about 15 percent of the upstream universe is missing, ZIP and FIPS codes lose leading zeros on naive import, and energy use, employment and production volumes are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives a point layer of factories to expose to hazards, to place industrial electricity, gas and water demand on networks, and to size onsite energy potential per site. Related catalogue records include the EPA Toxics Release Inventory, Climate TRACE and the Energy and Industry Facilities Composite.
